_how_to_use: Each clip in queue/ must name a campaign key from this file (in its .json sidecar, field 'campaign'). Clips with no valid, active campaign are NOT posted. Add one entry per Whop/Vyro campaign you join. 'organic' is only for content you own or have explicit permission to post.

organic.name: Organic (no paid campaign)
organic.notes: Only for content you own or have explicit permission to post. No #ad.

example-whop-campaign.name: Example: Whop campaign name
example-whop-campaign.notes: Copy the campaign's rules here (required sound, tags, banned edits). Set active to true once you've joined.

boxabl.name: Boxabl Official Clipping (Clip Farm, Whop Content Rewards)
boxabl.submit_where: contentrewards.com -> Boxabl Official Clipping -> Submit clip
caption_rules: Tag @boxabl in every caption (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube).
Caption must be about Boxabl: the Casita, foldable homes, or the factory.
Spell the brand BOXABL correctly (all caps is fine).
Positive tone toward Boxabl, its product and featured talent.
Never mention Boxabl stock, shares, investing in Boxabl, or any ticker symbol.
No engagement bait, no politics or controversy.
clip_rules: Only Boxabl-approved footage (sources.json). Never use clips of Kanye.
Show the whole Boxabl home at some point, not only close-up details.
Brand must be clear: the on-screen hook title must contain the word BOXABL (or Boxabl must be said in the clip).
Hook in the first 2 seconds; bold captions for muted viewing (ClipKit adds these).
Real edits only (captions, cuts, hooks) - never a raw rip. Vary moments; never repeat the same moment.
Positive moments only: the unfolding, the space, the price/value wow, the factory scale, celebrity reactions.
No other brands' watermarks; avoid moments dominated by another brand's logo or sponsor read.
boxabl.payment_notes: Pays only if at least 40% of the clip's audience is US/UK/CA/AUS. 'Share audience demographics' is required when submitting. Up to $500 per clip.
boxabl.notes: Optional: Boxabl affiliate program at boxabl.com/affiliate.

scary-stories.name: Scary stories (original, AI-narrated, Minecraft parkour background)
caption_rules: Line 1 hooks with the story's scariest unanswered question or the wrong detail from the title. Never spoil the ending.
It's fiction: never say 'true story', 'this really happened', or that it came from Reddit or a real person.
End the caption with the clip's gameplay credit exactly as given in `credit` (e.g. 'Gameplay: Orbital - No Copyright Gameplay').
No gore words, no real people, brands or real tragedies.
scary-stories.notes: Fully automated: the nightly factory writes original stories (tools/STORY_PROMPT.txt) and renders them with tools/story_maker.py. Not a paid campaign: income comes from TikTok Creator Rewards / YouTube Partner Program once the accounts qualify.
scary-stories.paused_note: Paused 2026-11-17 by the user to focus on the Clix GTA VI campaign (@mediarawcut should look like a GTA/Clix clip page, and Reach bans AI content). Finished story videos stay in queue/. Set active true and paused false to resume.

gta6-template.name: TEMPLATE: GTA VI streamer campaign (copy to gta6-<streamer>, fill in from the campaign page)
gta6-template.submit_where: contentrewards.com -> the campaign -> Submit (within the campaign's time limit after posting)
caption_rules: Tag the streamer's handle and say where they stream (e.g. 'live on Twitch').
No story spoilers in the hook or the first second.
Copy any other caption rule from the campaign page here.
clip_rules: Only this streamer's own stream clips (the brief is the permission).
Only GTA VI gameplay moments unless the brief allows other content.
Reject clips that are mostly in-game radio music, menus, loading screens or other creators' content.
Copy any other clip rule from the campaign page here (length, layout, banned edits).
gta6-template.notes: Delete fields you don't need. 'twitch' is the channel login the PC downloader uses. 'facecam' is X,Y,W,H in the source video (set by the GTA clip job the first time it sees the stream layout).

gta6-clix.name: Clix GTA VI Marathon Pool ($5,000, Reach on Content Rewards)
gta6-clix.submit_where: contentrewards.com -> the campaign -> Submit (within the campaign's time limit after posting)
caption_rules: The on-screen hook AND the caption must both say 'Clix' by name.
The caption must include #Clix (and #ad for the paid disclosure).
English only, US-friendly wording, no slang from outside the US/UK/CA/AU/NZ. Tag a US location only if the clip is about one.
Never portray Clix negatively, never 'hate farm' or invent a negative story about him.
No GTA VI story spoilers in the hook or first second.
clip_rules: Only footage from Clix's GTA VI marathon (began Nov 18, 2026): his stream, videos or clips.
Clix must be the primary focus of the clip (his webcam, voice or reaction carries it).

No AI-generated content of any kind: no AI voiceover, AI images or AI-made video. These clips are real stream footage plus captions only. Set isAiGenerated false. ONE STRIKE BANS THE ACCOUNT FROM EVERY REACH CAMPAIGN.
No logos or watermarks added. No on-screen #AD badge (disclosure goes in the caption).
Never post the same clip twice, never collab-post, never anything that could look like boosting views.
Never submit a scary-story video to this campaign.

hashtags.how_to_use: 5 tags: all of always + 1 core (rotate) + 1 by_topic. Keep #Clix capitalised exactly; others lowercase.
